findings.reason: the node would either place the wait around the whole cache-miss path in `index_rows` (before `_reuse_covered`) or add a waiter-side assertion that no `covered_dir_identity`/`_reuse_covered` call is rerun per reader; without that the section can be closed on a passing gate that leaves the measured defect in place.
findings.text: §17's gate counts only `build_index` calls, but the served cold path runs two full directory stat sweeps per reader: `index_rows` calls `_reuse_covered` (`reckon/metadata_index.py:496`) before `_build_and_cache`, and `_reuse_covered` stats every recorded directory at `metadata_index.py:743`, while `build_index` stats every one of them again at `metadata_index.py:877-880`. A single-flight placed around the build alone therefore leaves each of N readers with its own `_reuse_covered` sweep, so the gate can go green on "one `build_index` call" while most of the 6.10 s cost §17 exists to remove remains, and even the leader still pays both sweeps — the deliverable's claim that "concurrent first reads pay for one sweep" is not what the measured mechanism produces.
